notes: TESTER BUILD: this release has not had a clean fleet pass yet; it is published so testers can run the newest build.
Smaller update: Sigil is about 115 MB lighter. Bathysphere now carries only the five pictures it shows, in a compact format, with no visible difference.
Bathysphere on small screens: the zoom into its monitors now always keeps a sensor reading next to the time (it could show the time alone on a 240x320 screen).
